journey.name: pause automatic funding after explicit primary close
journey.description: Requires a disposable regtest wallet with a funded primary connection and sufficient provider funds. This closes the connection and spends network fees. Keep the same app wallet and node identity across restarts. This Android flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Open Settings, Advanced, Lightning Connections and cooperatively close the selected primary connection
Wait for closure confirmation and returned funds, then verify automatic funding does not reopen the connection
Restart Bitkit, allow the wallet to sync and verify the funds remain onchain with no reopened connection
Open Primary node and verify the paused-funding notice (testTag "PrimaryNodeFundingPaused")
While funding is paused, choose an unreachable primary and verify failed connection leaves funding paused and the previous primary retained
Tap Connect node for the same compatible primary and verify the pause notice disappears after successful verification
With at least 25,000 confirmed sats and funding fees below the limit, verify automatic funding opens a new connection after wallet sync
